label: PINCER 4
statement: Proportions of women with a past medical history of venous or arterial thrombosis who have been prescribed the combined oral contraceptive pill - More specifically, women with a history of venous or arterial thrombosis recorded at least six months prior to data collection who have a computer-recorded prescription for the combined oral contraceptive pill in the six months prior to data collection.
